reason: A proposes a plausible, testable thermal-aging/impurity-segregation pathway supported by evidence that nominally single-phase RHEAs phase-separate near 700–800°C, although it overextends that evidence from softening to brittle fracture and does not cleanly isolate stress from temperature. B is less physically grounded because its cited studies show nanotwinning and related mechanisms enhancing ductility and crack-tip shielding rather than causing embrittlement.
